decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed roof extension  because of its position, 
          design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the 
          site characteristics of number 287 Popes Lane and is complimentary to the 
          visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities 
         of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in 
         accordance with the adopted UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development), 
         ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVN 1.7 (Development near the 
         Metropolitan Land Boundary), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4  
         (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for Developments)  of the 
         London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extension is used.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the east and west elevations shall be obscure glazed and repaired with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse.
